There are so many wonders on earth. We
need to take care of them.
Mount Qomolangma is the world's highest
mountain. It was 8,848.86 metres high in
2020. And it is slowly getting higher over
time. lt will be higher in the future.
What is the world's biggest
desert? You may say the Sahara.

million square kilometres.
The longest river in the world is the Nile.
It is about 6,671 kilometres long. It runs
across 11 countries. There is little rain in
Africa. So the Nile is very important.

Doctor What's the matter？

headache.
Doctor Let me see.. Well, it looks
like you have the flu.
Look! These are viruses. They can

Viruses are very small. You can't see
them at all. They fly into your body
from your mouth and nose.

sore throat. You may also have a
headache. Sometimes you can have
a cough and a fever, too.

doctor？
